analysis.title: US EQUITIES COLOR: ON THE WEEK 23 Oct 2026
key_insights: GS floor saw about $20bn of net TMT selling (Info Tech + Comm Services) over the past 2 weeks across all client types and execution channels, close to the -$23bn net sold over 2 weeks in the July AI selling episode.
Mood is described as 'still pretty terrible' with performance challenges persisting, and the desk saw zero signs of offense being played around the AI theme during the week.
Last week's AI selloff saw rotation into defensives, but little of that showed today despite gains in Consumer, Utilities and pockets of Financials.
US equities were net sold for a 3rd straight week (4 of the last 5), driven mainly by long and short sales in Single Stocks, which saw the largest de-grossing since late July.
Industrials was among the most net sold sectors, with hedge funds selling the group at the fastest pace in 6+ months.
Real Estate and Staples were by far the most net bought sectors this week, which the desk reads as a continued defensive posture.
Next week S&P implied move through Friday 10/30 is 1.80%, with FOMC + BOC on Wednesday, ECB Thursday and BOJ Friday.
Next week is the heaviest of Q3 earnings, with 44% of S&P market cap reporting: MSFT, GOOG, NOW, KLAC Wednesday and AMZN, INTC Thursday.
Brazil election results are due Sunday night. Polymarket has Bolsonaro at a 76% chance of winning, while local polls show him 0-2.5pt ahead.
